recipe_version.title: Glazed Turkey Meatloaf with Lemon Green Beans
recipe_version.description: A tender, juicy turkey meatloaf shaped free-form on a sheet pan and brushed with a tangy ketchup, brown sugar, and Dijon glaze that bakes into a sticky lacquer. Green beans roast on the same pan and get a squeeze of lemon and parsley.

steps.title: Preheat and mix
steps.body: Turn the oven on to 375 F to preheat with a rack in the middle, and line a sheet pan with parchment. In a large bowl stir the panko, eggs, milk, grated onion, garlic, soy sauce, thyme, 1 1/2 tsp salt, and 1/2 tsp pepper; rest 3 minutes, then add the turkey and mix gently with your hands just until combined. Shape into a 9 x 4-inch loaf on one side of the pan. Whisk the ketchup, brown sugar, and Dijon in a small bowl. Trim the beans.

steps.title: Bake the loaf
steps.body: Brush the loaf with half the glaze and bake in the preheated 375 F oven 35 minutes.

steps.title: Add the beans and glaze again
steps.body: Toss the green beans with the olive oil, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1/4 tsp pepper and spread them on the open side of the pan. Brush the loaf with the remaining glaze. Bake 20 minutes more, until the loaf reads 165 F in the center and the beans are tender and browned in spots.

steps.title: Rest and finish
steps.body: Rest the meatloaf 10 minutes. Toss the beans with the lemon zest, a squeeze of lemon juice, and the parsley.

steps.title: Slice and serve
steps.body: Slice the meatloaf 1 inch thick and serve with the green beans and lemon wedges.
